_help: The crawler only buys an item when its profit (NPC pays - asking price, per item) is at least min_profit for the highest price_from the asking price reaches. min_total_profit: a purchase is skipped unless quantity x profit per item reaches this (for a market deal the profit is an estimate: selling at the 24h median, minus the 3% shop fee). sell_below_budget_percent: in full_sell_loop.bat, go and sell once under this percent of the budget is left. big_buy: an NPC deal costing more than over_budget_percent of the session budget is skipped unless its profit is at least min_flip_percent of the asking price. never_buy: items whose name contains any of these words (any case) are always skipped. skip_shops_with: shops whose sign contains any of these (any case, spaces ignored) aren't opened at all. review_items: listings of these get a purple box (and the crawler beeps and waits a few seconds) so you can look at their stats yourself (one priced under what an NPC pays is still bought as a deal). market: every item seen in a store is checked against Free Market prices from MeowDB (looked up the first time it shows up); a listing at least below_24h_median_percent under the item's median price of the last 24 hours is a market deal, if that median comes from at least min_reports_24h reports. Market deals on items in auto_buy are bought like NPC deals; all others stop on the purchase window for you to press OK or Cancel. Every market buy is logged to logs/market_buys.txt with its break-even selling price. crafting (craft_calculator.bat): which disciplines' recipes to check, the profit margin (percent of what a craft sells for) its buy-under prices leave you, how many market reports a price needs before it's trusted, and the highest craft level to include (the live game stops at 8; levels 9 and 10 were only in the test server). Edit freely.

store_deals._min_scroll_price: a scroll that sells for under this isn't a store deal: the cheap niche ones (Pet Equip Jump, Topwear DEF and the like) mostly pass between merchants and are hardly used. Those in scroll_allow are, whatever their price
store_deals._stack_sizes: store deals hold at most one stack of an item: MeowDB's stack size, or 100 if it has none. Set an item's here to change it, like {"Stiff Feather": 100}

_hold: bought at up to over_npc mesos over the NPC's price and kept, never sold at the NPC: equipment of this subtype from min_level up (data/equipment_stats.json). From the custom and store money when the budget is split
_never_buy: never bought in any way (NPC, market, store or held): an item whose name has any of these in it, any case. Blackbull's Deed is a quest item each character needs once (stock would be stuck); Stiff Feather and Wolbi aren't worth it
